<!-- pr-reviewer: b896d9758ae8ad92be64ee03c9477d6ae5979078 -->
**Needs a maintainer look only for the standing Hub hold: no blockers found. Stays a draft; merges after #1395.**

Head b896d9758 (stacked on #1395, replaces #952). The earlier head e091d78 was reviewed clean on #952; this is a full review of the merged result.

**What looks good**
- The two changes combine cleanly in `assets/posts/doosan-dnm.cps`. `spindleStopped()` is still first in `onLinear` and `onCircular` (lines 789 and 808), ahead of the new `feedWord()`.
- `lastA/B/C = null` at tool change (595) and section end (693) means the first A of each program or section is always written, A0 included. In `onRapid`, `onLinear` and `onCircular`, `aChanged` unclamps before the move and clamps after it (rapid) or leaves the clamp to the existing path. TCP re-arm writes all three angles. A later turn back to A0 is detected against the held value, so it unclamps.
- The cap cannot be bypassed. Every A, B or C move goes through `feedWord()` (linear 790, arc 809). Rapids have no F, and `heldAngles()` records only letters actually written. An angle unknown after the reset is refused by name once a rotary rate is stated (pinned by `a_feed_turning_from_an_unknown_angle_is_refused_by_name`). So no move refused before now passes silently.
- Units come from `postOptions.Units` (line 560) and are passed to `rotaryFeed` as `inch`. The machine file is never read for units.
- The `fourth_axis_pose.rs` change adds a placing rapid, as the refusal now requires, and its comment explains why. No golden or snapshot changed. No dependency, build.rs, `.github` or script changes. Decision files are present for both issues.

**Local results (merged with main; main was already contained, so no conflicts)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-post` | all suites ok, 0 failures |
| app `rotary_feed_cap` | 11 passed |
| app `doosan_dnm_a_state` | 2 passed |
| app `fourth_axis_pose` | 9 passed |
| app `c_axis_unwind` | 7 passed |
| app `post_unit_word` | 5 passed |
| app `program_units` | 7 passed |
| clippy post + app, `--all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

**Mutation checks (reverted locally, then restored)**
- Resetting `lastA/B/C` back to 0 at the two reset sites turned both `doosan_dnm_a_state` tests red.
- Bypassing `feedWord()` in `onLinear` turned 9 of 11 `rotary_feed_cap` tests red.

**Requested before merge:** none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `fanuc.cps` carries the same cap code but keeps `lastA = 0`. That is out of scope for #950, which is the Doosan post.
- Not exercised here: a real machine. The PathPilot Hub run the maintainer is holding both drafts for still stands.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Hub hold lifted by the maintainer (2026-11-13: "1396 looks right as well and can be merged"). Flagged ready on the clean review of head b896d975; nothing was pushed after that review. #1395 merged first (3de5be38).

Blended upper estimate (90 % input / 10 % output at list price). Main-session coordination isn't counted.

Effort: effort:high
